title: Outlook: Calendar support for copying, cutting, and pasting events and appointments
description: Customers can now copy, cut, and paste meetings and appointments on their calendar in the new Outlook using CTRL+C, CTRL+X, and CTRL+V keyboard shortcuts. #newoutlookforwindows
